threads.Text: [Q] Assumption: activation = handing off a `plan`-template doc. Research and design docs never lock code. Is that the right trigger, or should you activate a plan explicitly (e.g. /review-doc --activate)?
threads.SectionPath: Plan Contract Loop > Implementation Phases > Phase 2 — Gate code edits on the approved hash

Anchor.selected_text: A plan becomes active when Claude hands off a doc that uses the `plan` template.

Replies.Author: rcliao
Replies.Text: Yes, plan is the good hand off and should be the only point that agent hand to human to review. Research, design doc are guiding doc that supports the plan (that plan doc can refer to in case human wants more detail)
